clue.text: Write in bed in quarters

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in here means the bed sits between the two compass quarters

parts.note: S and E, south and east, are two quarters of the compass
a crib is a small bed for a baby

explanation.surface: Someone writing in bed while staying in lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: To inscribe is to engrave or set down words on a surface, a formal synonym for writing.

clue.text: Favoured portly round figure-really!

parts.note: in means fashionable, in favour

indicators.note: round here means the word for portly goes round the figure

parts.note: fat means portly, stout
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a round figure

explanation.surface: An exclamation at someone favouring a stout, round shape.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an emphatic way of saying actually or indeed.

clue.text: Wild tale told about Mohammedan leader

indicators.note: about means the tale goes round the other letter

parts.note: a story is a tale

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A dramatic account told of a religious figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Stormy weather or a stormy temper is turbulent and violent.

clue.text: Give the right tip with little hesitation

parts.note: an end is a tip or extremity
er is the small sound people make when hesitating

explanation.surface: Advice on tipping correctly, after a moment's doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: To render is to give or provide, as in rendering a service.

clue.text: For disabled dons in the West Country?

definitions.note: the definition describes what the vehicles are for, a person unable to walk

indicators.note: in here places the dons after the city, as residents of it

parts.note: Bath is a city in Somerset, in England's south-western West Country
a chair is a professorship, held by a senior don at a university

explanation.surface: Asking whether university lecturers in south-west England are disabled.
explanation.walkthrough: A bath chair is an old hooded wheelchair, named after the spa city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath chairs were wheeled seats used by invalids to be pushed about.

clue.text: CID men possibly cut things fine

indicators.note: possibly says these letters might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Detectives from the CID may be cutting it fine on a case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' shuffles CIDMEN; CID is the British police's Criminal Investigation Department.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that is minced has been chopped into very small pieces.

clue.text: Recognise, but deny it if confused

indicators.note: confused letters are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone who knows a face yet, muddled, denies it.
explanation.definitionFit: To identify someone is to recognise who they are.

clue.text: Oriental feature a fellow read

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: Looking at a man's face and reading its eastern features.
explanation.walkthrough: 'read' is left as a link; the term is dated and offensive today.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an old, now offensive term for a person from China, an Oriental.

clue.text: I'd go back and point to bloomer as a calamity

indicators.note: go back means the letters of I'd are written backwards

parts.note: S, south, is a compass point
an aster is a flower, so something that blooms

explanation.surface: Someone retreating to point out a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' suggests a blunder but means a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A disaster is a sudden great misfortune, a calamity.

clue.text: Comment on the pedicurist's record?

parts.note: a pedicurist treats the foot, so the foot is the pedicurist's concern
a note is a written record, as in taking a note

explanation.surface: A remark about the paperwork a foot specialist keeps.
explanation.definitionFit: A footnote is a remark printed at the bottom of a page, an added comment.

clue.text: Lax young woman, a follower soldiers of soldiers

indicators.note: a follower here means the young woman comes after the soldiers in the answer

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is the usual crossword abbreviation for soldiers
a miss is a young unmarried woman

explanation.surface: A careless girl who tags along with the troops.
explanation.walkthrough: The newspaper text repeats 'soldiers'; the clue was 'Lax young woman, a follower of soldiers'.
explanation.definitionFit: Remiss means negligent or careless in one's duty, the same as lax.

clue.text: Force holding thousands means business

indicators.note: holding means the word for force wraps round the thousands

parts.note: to coerce is to force someone
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so MM is two thousands

explanation.surface: Coercion that controls big money is what drives trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Commerce is the buying and selling of goods, trade on a large scale.

clue.text: In the streets a light goes off

indicators.note: In places the light within the abbreviation for streets

parts.note: ST is short for street, so STS is streets
a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: A street lamp switches itself off at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who strays wanders off or deviates from the proper course.

clue.text: Low-level illumination

parts.note: lamps set along the front edge of a stage floor, lighting performers from below

explanation.definitionFit: Theatre lights placed at stage level shine up from the lowest point.

clue.text: Conceal nothing-pull a glum face about it

indicators.note: to pull a face is to twist it, so these letters are distorted
about signals the letters are turned round into a new order

parts.note: O, the round figure zero, stands for nothing

explanation.surface: Advice to hide one's feelings by not frowning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pull' and 'about' together rearrange O plus AGLUMFACE.
explanation.definitionFit: To camouflage something is to disguise it so it blends in and cannot be seen.

clue.text: Trader created French sea song

parts.note: mer is French for sea
a chant is a simple song

explanation.surface: A dealer who composed a French shanty.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchant is someone who buys and sells goods, a trader.

clue.text: Note seeing some improvement

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
vision is the power of seeing

explanation.surface: Noticing that things have got somewhat better.
explanation.definitionFit: A revision is an amended version, a change made to improve something.

clue.text: Poor sailors' accommodation

parts.note: the cheapest quarters on a passenger ship, for those who travel with little money, though it sounds like a place for bad helmsmen

explanation.definitionFit: The lowest-fare section of a ship housed impoverished voyagers.

clue.text: Those not in the minority choose to speak out

parts.note: to elect is to choose by vote
to orate is to speak formally in public

explanation.surface: The majority decide to make their voices heard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'minority' looks like the smaller group; it means being under age, and only adults may vote.
explanation.definitionFit: The voters are those who have reached their majority, the age at which one may vote.

clue.text: Taking break in South Africa or ancient Greek city

indicators.note: in places the break inside South Africa's abbreviation

parts.note: to part is to break apart

explanation.surface: Taking a holiday in South Africa or in ancient Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparta was the militaristic city-state of the ancient Peloponnese.

clue.text: Put off the track as the queen enters parliament

indicators.note: enters means the queen goes inside the parliament

parts.note: the Dail is the lower house of the Irish parliament
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the queen

explanation.surface: A monarch's arrival at parliament throws proceedings off course.
explanation.definitionFit: To derail is to make a train leave its rails.

clue.text: Doesn't make port

indicators.note: make here means the letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: A ship that fails to reach harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make' rearranges DOESNT; Ostend is a Belgian port.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostend is a ferry port on the coast of Belgium.

clue.text: It's all change on Eric's job

definitions.text: It's all change on Eric's job

indicators.note: all change, the call at a terminus, tells us to rearrange these letters

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Eric's job involves constant upheaval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all change' shuffles ONERIC; one who makes coins produces nothing but change.
explanation.definitionFit: A coiner mints money, especially counterfeit coins, so small change is his whole trade.

clue.text: Lack of guts left the head without one representative

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the one and the representative stand before the head

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Sheerness

explanation.surface: A leader who walked out leaves the group spineless.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpness is floppiness or lack of firmness, a want of spirit.

clue.text: Sensual product of Manila

indicators.note: a product is something made from raw material, so these letters are remade

explanation.surface: Something manufactured in the Philippine capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective means physical or carnal, relating to bodily appetites.

clue.text: Need a little time?

parts.note: short means of little length
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone asking for a moment's grace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little time' read literally is a brief era.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortage is a lack, a state of want.

clue.text: Present for the caretaker

definitions.meaning: to ... is to offer or present, as in ... a resignation
one who looks after something, as a bartender or a carer

explanation.definitionFit: Offering something formally and minding things are both senses of the same word.

clue.text: The routed side, alas, gets set upon

indicators.note: routed means put to disorderly flight, so these letters are scattered

explanation.surface: A beaten team laments being attacked.
explanation.definitionFit: Assailed means attacked, set upon violently.
